cases.script_content:
import os
from playwright.sync_api import sync_playwright

BASE_URL = os.environ.get("TARGET_URL", "http://127.0.0.1:5098/")


def main():
    os.makedirs("test-results", exist_ok=True)
    with sync_playwright() as p:
        browser = p.chromium.launch()
        page = browser.new_page()
        page.goto(BASE_URL, wait_until="networkidle")
        page.screenshot(path="test-results/home_order_list_title.png")
        body_text = page.inner_text("body")
        assert "订单列表" in body_text, f"首页未显示订单列表标题，页面内容: {body_text[:200]}"
        browser.close()
    print("PASS: 首页显示订单列表标题")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

preconditions: Web 服务已在 http://127.0.0.1:5098/ 启动并可访问
首页存在订单列表及“查看详情”入口
已安装 Playwright 及 Chromium 浏览器
cases.script_content:
import os
from playwright.sync_api import sync_playwright

BASE_URL = os.environ.get("TARGET_URL", "http://127.0.0.1:5098/")


def main():
    os.makedirs("test-results", exist_ok=True)
    with sync_playwright() as p:
        browser = p.chromium.launch()
        page = browser.new_page()
        page.goto(BASE_URL, wait_until="networkidle")
        detail = page.get_by_text("查看详情").first
        assert detail.count() > 0, "首页未找到“查看详情”入口"
        detail.click()
        page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
        page.screenshot(path="test-results/order_detail_after_click.png")
        body_text = page.inner_text("body")
        assert "订单详情" in body_text, f"点击查看详情后未显示订单详情，页面内容: {body_text[:200]}"
        browser.close()
    print("PASS: 点击查看详情后显示订单详情")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
